what: `tracing::error!(target: "blaze", ..)` from a thread of the daemon that is no job's is in no file a person reads: the launch driver's refusal of a launcher was nowhere (`serve.log` has the memory lines only), and the launcher said only `the daemon's socket ended: the daemon closed it`.
cost: a rebuild to carry the reason to the launcher before the cause could be read
cause: the daemon's own stderr and its tracing go to different places, and an error outside a build has no reader
workaround: the driver tells the launcher why (`Tell::Unheld`) before it closes the socket
